summary: Lloyds Banking Group plc filed a Form 6-K on May 1, 2026, reporting the allotment and issuance of 20,518,682 ordinary shares of 10p each between March 4 and April 30, 2026, under existing block admissions to satisfy share plan awards. The shares were admitted to trading on the London Stock Exchange Main Market. No price, premium, or board recommendation was given. The filing is a routine equity issuance, not a special situation. There are no deal terms to report.
